@graph.rdfs:comment: A VHP4Safety case study: a Study with its regulatory questions, each answered by a workflow (CaseStudyWorkflow profile), and the sections of its page. It adds to the Bioschemas Study profile, which applies too. Version: 0.1-DRAFT.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the case study.

headline.description: The heading of its page, if it differs from the name.

abstract.title: Introduction to the questions
abstract.description: The text above the regulatory questions on its page, in HTML.

text.title: Text
text.description: The text of its page in HTML, if it is not in sections.

image.title: Icon
image.description: The icon of the case study, shown on the case studies page.

hasPart.title: Questions and sections
hasPart.description: The regulatory questions of the case study, each with the workflow that answers it, and the sections of its page.

question.description: A regulatory question, with the workflow that answers it (CaseStudyWorkflow profile).

section.description: A section of the page: a heading, a text in HTML and its position.
